fields.Name: ORD-02 - Revenue Recognition
fields.Description: Recognition is forward-dated LEDGER, not a nightly job (RR1-RR7, D14/D43). A straight-line deferred line writes one booking entry plus twelve forward-dated releases that sum exactly to the line amount; each release is Dr Deferred / Cr Sales so the deferral round-trip closes; the order line points at the BOOKING entry; an event line earns 100% on its end date; an up-front line credits Sales directly and writes no releases at all.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 12 releases summing to 1200 with distinct future dates; 24 ledger lines Dr 21301 / Cr 40100; AllBackEnd earns on the end date; UpFront writes zero releases.
